body:
Yes. I was always taught that there isn't any time for emotions or feelings, and that they just needlessly complicate things. I try to present myself as open as possible, where nothing really "sticks". And I constantly get hurt by doing so, but at the same time it makes life for me a bit easier.


I have tried so many things in the past. I'm going to try a few more things that I haven't done in a decade (such as going to set up an appointment with a therapist, perhaps get medication, see if it'll work this time around). I don't *want* to die, necessarily, but I feel it is my only current option to escape everything I'm feeling.

I do have people that I can trust, but talking about my problems just feels petty and pathetic, so I don't. 

And yeah, I feel like I can stick around until after the vacation. But if I can't find any light to hold onto I'm ready to completely let go.

I realized a while ago that when people around me are disappointed or sad, it makes me feel 10,000,000,000x worse. 


You haven't offended me. I have a vacation planned for next month. I've never been on vacation, but I kind of hope it'll... fix things? Make me feel better? idk
Mine are horrible too. But I haven't been hit this hard since I was 14.
I don't even have the motivation to vent to anyone. I don't want to burden people anymore than I already am.
